first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Blue Sky
entities.identification: A smooth background area outside the horizon, ranging from light blue to nearly white, that moves with the roll from the left side of the frame, past the bottom and right side, to the top.

entities.name: Dry Grassland
entities.identification: A light yellow-brown ground surface occupying most of the frame, with low, grass-like clumps alternating with bare-earth-colored areas and a rough, mottled texture.

entities.name: Scattered Trees and Shrubs
entities.identification: Multiple rounded or irregular clumps of vegetation distributed at intervals across the grassland, with crowns ranging from greenish brown to light brown and accompanied by slender, dark shadows.

entities.name: Dirt Road and Linear Track
entities.identification: A relatively wide brown dirt strip beyond the foreground grassland, along with localized linear ground marks; it is on the left side of the frame at frame 0 and in the left midground at frame 35, extending toward the upper part.
